# **C \- Existing Apps Survey**

**Performed by:** Nguyễn Công Kiên, Trịnh Văn Thành

**Reviewed by:** Nguyễn Hoàng Gia

## Thế Giới Di Động *([thegioididong.com](http://thegioididong.com))*

| ![][image1] ![][image2] | Homepage (flash sale): The homepage promotes time-limited deals in a tabbed section that can be filtered by category. A countdown shows the time left in the current session, and the next session's start time is displayed beside it. Product cards show the sale price, original price, discount percentage, rating, units sold, and a progress bar of remaining discounted slots, with a "Mua ngay" button for quick purchase. The countdown, limited slots, and sold counts create urgency and social proof.  |
| :---- | :---- |
| ![][image3] | **Homepage (suggestion)**  Below the promotions, the homepage shows a "Suggestions for you" grid of products across categories, and above it a row of brand-themed collections with promotional taglines. Each card shows the product name, key specs as tags (such as screen, RAM, and storage), price and discount, installment badge, rating, and units sold. Putting specs directly on the card helps shoppers compare options without opening each page.  |
| ![][image4] | **Search suggestions and support footer:**  A "Mọi người cũng tìm kiếm" (People also search) section lists popular queries that the user can click to search instantly. The footer provides hotlines for purchasing, complaints, and warranty, and a store locator showing the number of stores. This helps users find products quickly and know where to get help.  |
| ![][image5] ![][image6] | **Search bar dropdown:**  Clicking the search bar opens a panel with the user's recent searches (which can be cleared), a voucher the user can claim, and shortcuts to current campaigns and featured products. This helps returning users repeat searches quickly and lets the store promote offers at the moment the user is about to look for something.  **Search result**: Sort options, 0% installment badge, free gift value, and quick links to sub-categories  |
| ![][image7] ![][image8] | **Product page:** The page starts with the product name, breadcrumb path, rating, units sold, and links to the full specifications and the comparison tool. On the left is an image gallery with arrows and thumbnails, with the store's warranty commitments below it. The right panel shows the price (with the original price and discount, adjustable by location), available promotions and vouchers with their conditions, shipping information, and loyalty points. A sticky bar at the bottom stays visible while the user scrolls and offers "Add to cart", "Buy now", and "0% installment" at all times, so the user can act without scrolling back up. Collecting price, promotions, and warranty in one place helps the customer decide quickly  **Information panel:** Include measurement and technical info of the product. |
| ![][image9] | **Product comparison:** After choosing "So sánh" on a product page, the user sees a side-by-side view of up to three products from the same category. The top row shows each product's image, price, discount, rating, and units sold, and a button to remove it from the comparison. Below, a technical specifications table aligns each attribute in rows so the user can compare power, ports, size, and features at a glance. |
| ![][image10] | **Review and Rating:** Lower on the product page, a review section summarizes customer feedback with the average rating, the number of satisfied customers, and a bar chart showing the percentage of reviews at each star level, along with a strip of photos uploaded by customers. Below the summary, each review shows the reviewer's name, star rating, comment, optional photos, a "verified buyer" badge, and how long they used the product, and other users can mark a review as helpful. The badge and usage time make reviews more credible, and the summary lets shoppers judge quality at a glance. |
|  ![][image11] ![][image12] | **Shopping cart:** The cart lists the selected products with image, name, variant (such as color), price, and a quantity control; reducing the quantity to zero turns the minus button into a trash icon, and a "Select all" checkbox with a "remove all" link manages multiple items. Bundled gift vouchers for the product are shown beneath each item. On the right, the user chooses between home delivery (using a saved address) and in-store pickup, where they must pick a store before continuing. The user can also enter a discount code, toggle loyalty points to reduce the total, and see the order total before pressing "Đặt mua" (Place order). Letting users select which items to buy lets them check out part of the cart, and showing gifts and totals early avoids surprises at payment. |
| ![][image13]![][image14] | **Add a delivery address:** When the user adds a new address (from the address book, cart, or checkout), a form asks for the recipient's title, full name, and phone number, then the delivery location. The user types the ward and city, then the house number and street, and the system shows a list of suggested addresses that match what they typed. Choosing one places a pin on a map so the user can confirm or adjust the exact location, and a "Change address" button lets them go back and edit. Required fields are marked with an asterisk, and the "Confirm" button saves the address. Address suggestions and map confirmation reduce typing errors, which matters for deliveries.   |
| ![][image15] | **Checkout page:**   The user reviews the delivery, discounts, and payment on a single page. When the cart contains items with different availability, the order is split into separate shipments ("Giao lần 1" and "Giao lần 2"), and the user can choose standard delivery (free, with an estimated time window) or express delivery for a fee for each shipment. Gift vouchers and optional add-on services appear under each product. On the right, the user can apply a discount code or loyalty points, then choose how much to pay now, either the full amount or a minimum deposit to hold the order, and then a payment method (installment credit, bank transfer, credit/debit card, or others). The payment summary shows the subtotal, shipping fee, discounts, total, and expected points, and updates as options change. Splitting shipments and allowing a deposit suit expensive electronics, where stock may differ and customers may not want to pay everything upfront |
| ![][image16] | **Awaiting order payment:**  After confirming checkout, the user lands on a payment page that shows a QR code for bank transfer with a countdown timer and a deadline, after which the order is automatically cancelled if unpaid. The user can instead pay by credit/debit card, VNPay QR, or ATM card. The page includes anti-fraud warnings (for example, not to transfer money to strangers or click suspicious delivery links). An order summary shows the order code, amount due now, amount due on delivery, and total, with buttons to change information, manage the order, or cancel it. Below it, the delivery details for each shipment are listed. The deadline and countdown prevent stock from being held indefinitely, and the page lets the user fix mistakes without starting over.  |
| ![][image17]![][image18] | **Banners:** Promotional banners on both sides advertise current campaigns, which suggests the store manages this content through an admin tool  |
| ![][image19] | **Sign in page**: Sign-in with a phone number only.  |
| ![][image20] | **Profile:** A sidebar menu: Purchased orders, Voucher wallet ("Kho voucher"), My information, and Log out. A loyalty points summary at the top (total points) with a QR code to download their app.  Two tabs: Personal information and Address book ("Sổ địa chỉ"). Editable fields: title (Mr/Ms), full name, birth date, and email. The Update button is disabled until a valid change is made, and the empty email shows an inline validation error ("Please enter email"). |
| ![][image21] | **Order history:**   A list of past orders with a date range filter (here the last year, with a button to change it). Status tabs to filter orders: All, Processing ("Đang tiếp nhận"), Delivering ("Đang giao"), Delivered ("Đã giao"), Cancelled ("Đã hủy"). Each order card shows the order number (with a copy icon), the item, the total, its status ("Thành Công" \= successful), and a "Xem chi tiết" link to the order details.  |

## CellphoneS ([cellphones.com.vn](https://cellphones.com.vn/))

| ![][image22] | Homepage: The homepage serves as the main shopping entry point. It provides a left-side product-category menu, a global search bar, account and cart controls, and large promotional banners for featured devices and campaigns. Additional campaign blocks such as financing and flash-sale promotions help users discover products through categories, featured offers, and current deals. |
| :---- | :---- |
| ![][image23] | Product category and filtering: The phone category page organizes the catalogue with brand filters such as Apple, Samsung, OPPO, Xiaomi, TECNO, HONOR, Sony, Nokia, and others. It also provides shortcuts based on usage needs, helping users narrow the catalogue before browsing the product cards shown below. |
| ![][image24] | Product detail page: The product detail screen presents the iPhone 17 Pro Max 256GB with its image gallery, star rating and review count, selling price, and installment estimate. Users can choose among storage versions and colour options, view promotional offers, and access actions such as favorite, Q\&A, and product comparison before deciding which configuration to purchase. |
| ![][image25] | Product comparison: The comparison screen places the iPhone 17 Pro 256GB and iPhone 17 Pro Max 256GB side by side. For each product, users can see the current and original price, installment estimate, short promotional information, and a purchase button. A specification table below allows technical differences between the two models to be reviewed directly. |
| ![][image26] | Shopping cart: The cart displays the selected product with its price and quantity controls before checkout. An order summary on the right shows voucher application, number of products, merchandise total, estimated discount, and final amount. Users can adjust the cart and proceed using the “MUA NGAY” action. |
| ![][image27] | Checkout \- customer, delivery, and payment information: The checkout screen combines customer information, fulfillment details, and payment selection. Users confirm their phone number and email, choose home delivery or store pickup, enter city, district, address, and delivery notes, and optionally request a company invoice. The order summary is shown on the right together with payment choices such as payment at the store, QR bank transfer, VNPAY, MoMo, and card payment before the user selects “THANH TOÁN”. |
| ![][image28] | Smember login: The Smember login screen supports sign-in with a phone number and password, password recovery, and social login through Google or Zalo. New customers can use the registration link to create an account. The left side also highlights Smember benefits such as member discounts, vouchers, birthday rewards, and other loyalty offers. |
| ![][image29] | Search: A global search field is placed prominently in the top navigation bar with the prompt “Bạn muốn mua gì hôm nay?”. This gives users a direct entry point to search for a specific product, brand, or device while remaining accessible from the main shopping interface. |
| ![][image30] | Profile Management: The Smember account dashboard shows membership information and personal account details in one place. Users can view and update their name, phone number, email, gender, and birthday, and manage saved delivery addresses through the address book. The sidebar also provides access to purchase history, warranty lookup, trade-in information, membership benefits, and other account services. |
| ![][image31] | Order Management: The purchase-history screen organizes orders using status tabs such as All, Pending Confirmation, Processing, Shipping, Received, and Cancelled. Users can filter orders by date and view each order's code, order date, purchased item, price, total amount, and current status. This provides a clear place to track previous and ongoing purchases. |
| ![][image32] | Review \+ Rating: The review section summarizes customer feedback with an overall score of 4.9/5, a star-distribution chart, and detailed ratings for product aspects such as recording quality, stabilization, audio recording, and battery. Users can select “Viết đánh giá”, filter reviews by image availability, verified purchase, or star level, and read individual customer reviews with ratings and feedback tags. |

## Summary

1. ### Common features

Both Thế Giới Di Động and CellphoneS follow the same overall structure. Customers find products through a global search bar, category navigation, and brand filters or sort options, then open a product page with an image gallery, price and discount, rating, promotions, and specifications. Both let customers compare products from the same category in a side-by-side specification table. Both show customer reviews with an average score, a star distribution chart, and verified-purchase marking. The purchase flow is also shared: a cart with quantity controls and voucher entry, a checkout offering home delivery or store pickup with several payment methods (bank transfer/QR, card, e-wallet), and an account area with an address book and an order history filtered by status tabs. Both also rely on promotional banners, loyalty programs, and installment payment.

2. ### What our app will do differently

Both sites are built for a large catalogue and a broad audience, so their pages carry many banners, promotions, and options. Our app targets customers who are not technically savvy and want to buy without much research:

- Both sites expect the customer to know what to look for, through keywords, brand filters, or fixed shortcuts such as CellphoneS’s usage-based categories. Our AI shopping assistant lets customers describe what they need in their own words, such as “a laptop for video editing under 30 million”, and returns matching products from the catalog with a short reason for each. This turns a static shortcut into a conversation.  
- Both sites show a raw specification table, which is hard to interpret for someone who doesn’t know what “Qi2.2” or “12GB/512GB” means. Our comparison view highlights the rows where products differ, so the customer sees the important differences first.

Especially, our applications will integrate the use of AI system in order to enhance the customer experience:

* An AI-powered chatbot that helps customers search for products using natural language, provides personalized recommendations and comparisons based on their needs, budgets, and preferences, and suggests compatible accessories or suitable alternatives. It supports conversational cart management, including adding, removing, replacing, and updating product quantities while clarifying missing details and displaying changes for review.  
* The assistant also guides customers through checkout preparation, including delivery options and order review, while leaving final order confirmation and payment to the customer. Additionally, it enables authenticated users to track orders and subscribe to restock notifications for unavailable product variants.

3. ### UI/UX patterns adoption

After surveying other existing options to our future product, we recognize that there are interface elements that have been implemented in both of the surveyed app, and has functionalities that we would want to adopt and use in our own site:

- Sticky action bar on the product page (Add to cart / Buy now), so the user can act without scrolling back up (Thế Giới Di Động).  
- Key specs as tags on product cards (RAM, storage, screen), so shoppers compare at a glance (Thế Giới Di Động).  
- Price display with the sale price, the struck-through original price, and the discount percentage (both).  
- Star distribution bar chart with a verified-buyer badge in reviews (both).  
- Side-by-side comparison table limited to products of the same category, with a remove button on each product (both).  
- Cart with item selection, a quantity stepper, and a summary panel on the right showing the live total (both).  
- Single-page checkout where the order summary updates as options change (both).  
- Status tabs and a date filter on order history (both).  
- Inline validation, with the Update button disabled until the change is valid, on profile forms (Thế Giới Di Động).  
- Recent-searches dropdown that the user can clear (Thế Giới Di Động).  
- Breadcrumb path and a global header with search and a cart item badge (both).
